title: NotteryBoost
description: A high-performance optimization pack for Fabric 1.21.11, built for a smooth mobile experience.
body:
### NotteryBoost
The ultimate performance-first experience for Minecraft 1.21.11.
Are you tired of lag, stuttering, and low frame rates? NotteryBosst is a carefully curated collection of the best performance and optimization mods available for Fabric. Designed specifically for mobile hardware, this pack strips away the bloat and keeps the game running as smoothly as possible.

🚀 Why Choose NotteryBosst?
Maximized FPS: We use the industry-standard "Core" performance mods to ensure your game runs at peak efficiency.
Stable Gameplay: No crashes, no memory leaks—just pure, uninterrupted Minecraft.
Modern Visuals: Experience better lighting and textures without the heavy performance cost.
Cinematic Tools: Includes smooth camera tools perfect for recording your builds and adventures.
Zero Bloat: We have intentionally excluded heavy UI or recipe mods to keep your RAM usage at an absolute minimum.

🛠️ What’s Inside?
This pack focuses on the essentials:
Performance: Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, FerriteCore, Debugify.
Visuals: Iris, Continuity, LambDynamicLights.
Camera: logical Zoom.

📥 How to Install
Download the modpack ZIP file.
Import the file directly into your Minecraft launcher.
Ensure you have the Fabric loader selected.
Launch and enjoy!
Note: For the best results, we recommend setting your render distance to 6–8 chunks.

💬 Support & Feedback
If you enjoy this pack, please consider leaving a like or a follow! If you encounter any issues, please report them in the "Issues" tab.
